_comment: Pinned cloudflared release and the SHA-256 of every asset this server
will download. Audit finding M-6: the download used
releases/latest/download with no integrity check, so what got chmod
755'd and executed changed without notice and HTTPS to github.com was
Cloudflare publishes no checksum file with its releases (verified
against the 2026.7.3 release: 26 assets, none of them a digest list),
so these were computed by downloading each asset over HTTPS and
hashing it. The digest is of the ASSET as downloaded -- the .tgz for
darwin, the bare binary for linux -- because that is the byte stream
To move the pin: bump `tag`, then for each asset run
and paste the result. A mismatch at runtime is a hard failure, never
